title: privacy-posture-evidence
description: Bounded, read-only AI privacy posture/egress evidence produced by `omes health ai-privacy` and lib/omes/py/privacy/posture_evidence.py (issue #216, ADR-0029). Every property is closed metadata - an enum, a bounded pattern, a boolean, or a timestamp. This shape MUST NEVER carry prompt text, response text, embeddings, retrieved documents, chain-of-thought, secrets/credentials, or a raw provider response; `evidence_source` and `hermes_version_reference.source` are drawn from a closed vocabulary (never free text) specifically so this contract cannot become a place to smuggle unbounded content.

policy_version.description: 'unknown' when the evaluator did not recognize the policy version supplied to it - the evidence is then unconditionally BLOCKED.

destination_class.description: Effective provider destination class per issue #216 scope.

cloud_fallback_enabled.description: Tri-state: only an explicit boolean observation resolves to 'enabled'/'disabled'; a missing or malformed observation is 'unknown', never assumed disabled.

last_verified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the observation this evidence was built from, or null when no timestamp was supplied (which forces BLOCKED).

evidence_source.description: Closed vocabulary, never free text - the structural control that makes it impossible for this field to carry a secret or prompt fragment.

local_only_posture.description: The #215 restricted local-only posture integration point. `available: false` (including when #215 has not landed yet) must never be treated as a healthy default by any consumer of this evidence.

hermes_version_reference.description: Upstream Hermes version/provenance reference where available, or null. `value` is bounded to a short version-banner shape - not arbitrary text - and a value that fails that bound is reported as null with a WARN reason code rather than echoed.

model_artifact_provenance.description: Issue #236 (threat AI-06) model/runtime artifact provenance/integrity evidence integration point: a local model must not be trusted merely because it is local. `available: false` (including before #236 evidence has ever been recorded) must never be treated as a healthy default - whenever `destination_class` is 'local' it degrades this evidence to BLOCKED (under a declared restricted_local_only posture) or WARN (otherwise). `status`/`reason` summarize the most recent `omes audit provenance --verify-artifacts` run; the underlying checksum hashing does not run on every evaluation (see docs/provenance.md) - only this small bounded summary is read here.

status.description: PASS/FAIL/WARN/BLOCKED. Unknown or stale evidence is always BLOCKED, never PASS. Drift from a restricted-local-only expected posture to an observed cloud destination is always FAIL.

reason_codes.description: Stable, machine-readable reason codes. Always non-empty. Distinct from (and never overloaded with) lib/omes/py/privacy/egress_policy.py's AI_EGRESS_* decision codes.
